summary: P6 lands exactly the five-key `reconciler: argo-cd` entry its Target names, and every key it carries is read on the consuming side — selector, local-chart template and autoSync patch — with the derived `argocd-prd` identity permitted by the AppProject and matching the P1 gate's release name. I mutation-tested all three new checks plus the `ours` short-circuit they protect; none is vacuous, and `deploy config` exits 0 across the whole tree with a falsy chart_name. Two advisory Minor findings, neither with a product consequence today; `audit-prd-orphans` is already recorded as close-out S11.

findings.summary: The tree-wide Argo-entry schema check asserts only the local-chart keys, so an upstream entry missing `upstream.repo`/`upstream.version` passes the gate and would fail generation for the whole upstream ApplicationSet.

The new whole-tree config test asserts `namespace == <dir>-<stage>` for every stage directory, contradicting the allowlisted and documented `namespace:` override key, so a correct future config would turn the gate red.
